data.body: Investigated: confirmed reproducible (this session required /reload-plugins to load 1 plugin / 3 skills / 45 agents / 14 hooks). Root cause is Claude Code harness behavior at session init — the plugin lifecycle hook for auto-loading plugins on session start may not be firing, OR the plugin discovery scan happens before the dso plugin's marketplace.json is parsed. Not fixable in dso codebase. Recommend: (a) escalate to Claude Code team, (b) document in INSTALL.md / WORKTREE-GUIDE.md as a known issue requiring /reload-plugins on session start, OR (c) add a session-init hook that emits a warning if dso:* skills aren't visible. Leaving open for user decision on path forward.
